description: Presidential Secretariat - Directive made to appoint Weligodage Kumarawansa De Silva Esquire as a member of the National Salaries and Cadre Commission
categorisation: This gazette contains a presidential directive appointing named individuals (Weligodage Kumarawansa De Silva and others listed) to the National Salaries and Cadre Commission.
